# Job Description - Technical Writer

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Job Descriptions](../README.md)**

---

> **Position**: Technical Writer
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Architecture Program Manager
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled Technical Writer to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will create, maintain, and optimize technical documentation and digital content for Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, combining advanced technical writing skills with web development capabilities to deliver engaging, accessible, and compliant documentation across multiple platforms and formats.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#technical-documentation--content-creation]

### Technical Documentation & Content Creation

- Create comprehensive technical documentation for enterprise architecture initiatives and healthcare systems
- Develop user guides, API documentation, system specifications, and process documentation
- Write and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs) and technical standards documentation
- Create training materials, tutorials, and knowledge base articles for internal and external audiences
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#markdown--documentation-as-code]

### Markdown & Documentation-as-Code

- Develop and maintain documentation using Markdown, Git, and documentation-as-code principles
- Implement automated documentation workflows and publishing pipelines
- Create and maintain documentation templates and style guides
- Integrate documentation with version control systems and CI/CD pipelines
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#web-development--sharepoint-solutions]

### Web Development & SharePoint Solutions

- Design and develop SharePoint sites, pages, and applications for documentation and collaboration
- Create responsive web interfaces for documentation portals and knowledge management systems
- Develop custom SharePoint web parts and applications using modern development frameworks
- Implement content management solutions and information architecture for digital platforms
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#healthcare-compliance-documentation]

### Healthcare Compliance Documentation

- Create documentation that meets healthcare regulatory requirements (HIPAA, MITA, FedRAMP)
- Develop compliance documentation for government healthcare programs and audits
- Ensure all documentation adheres to accessibility standards (ADA Section 508)
- Maintain documentation version control and audit trails for compliance purposes
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#digital-content-strategy--management]

### Digital Content Strategy & Management

- Develop content strategies for enterprise architecture knowledge management
- Manage documentation workflows and review processes
- Coordinate with subject matter experts to gather and validate technical content
- Optimize content for searchability, usability, and accessibility across multiple platforms

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in Technical Writing, Information Design, or Web Development
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 4+ years of experience in technical writing and documentation
- **Required**: 2+ years of experience with web development and SharePoint development
- **Preferred**: 3+ years of experience in healthcare technology or government documentation
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#documentation-expertise]

#### Documentation Expertise

- Advanced technical writing and editing skills
- Experience with documentation-as-code and version control (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
- Proficiency in Markdown, reStructuredText, and other markup languages
- Knowledge of documentation frameworks (Jekyll, Hugo, GitBook, MkDocs)
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#content-strategy--design]

#### Content Strategy & Design

- Information architecture and content organization principles
- User experience (UX) writing and content design
- Documentation workflow and process design
- Style guide development and content standardization
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#frontend-development]

#### Frontend Development

- Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+)
- Experience with modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js, or Angular)
- Responsive web design and mobile-first development principles
- Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2, Section 508)
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#sharepoint-development]

#### SharePoint Development

- SharePoint Online and SharePoint 2019/2016 development experience
- SharePoint Framework (SPFx) development and customization
- Power Platform integration (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
- SharePoint REST APIs and Microsoft Graph integration
page_texts.18:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#backend--integration]

#### Backend & Integration

- Basic understanding of backend technologies (Node.js, .NET, or Python)
- API documentation and integration experience
- Database basics and content management systems
- Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and deployment processes
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#documentation-tools]

#### Documentation Tools

- Advanced proficiency in documentation platforms (Confluence, Notion, GitBook)
- Static site generators and documentation frameworks
- Diagramming tools (Mermaid, Draw.io, Visio, Lucidchart)
- Content management and collaboration tools
page_texts.21:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#development-tools]

#### Development Tools

- Version control systems (Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub)
- Code editors and IDEs (VS Code, Visual Studio)
- Build tools and automation (npm, webpack, Azure DevOps pipelines)
- Testing and quality assurance tools
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- Microsoft SharePoint certifications (MS-600, MS-301, or equivalent)
- Web development certifications (Microsoft, Google, or industry-recognized)
- Technical writing certifications (STC, ISTC)

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#healthcare-industry-experience]

### Healthcare Industry Experience

- Experience creating documentation for healthcare technology and Medicaid systems
- Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and documentation requirements
- Understanding of healthcare compliance documentation (HIPAA, MITA, FedRAMP)
- Experience with government healthcare program documentation and reporting
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#advanced-technical-skills]

### Advanced Technical Skills

- Experience with headless CMS and modern content architecture
- Knowledge of SEO optimization and content analytics
- Understanding of DevOps practices and automation
- Experience with cloud-based documentation and collaboration platforms
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#specialized-knowledge]

### Specialized Knowledge

- Information security and privacy documentation experience
- Multilingual content development and localization
- Video production and multimedia content creation
- Training program development and instructional design
- Experience with Generative AI tools for content creation and documentation enhancement

---
page_texts.30:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#technical-writing-competencies]

### Technical Writing Competencies

- **Technical Communication**: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible documentation
- **Content Strategy**: Skills in developing comprehensive content strategies and information architecture
- **Quality Assurance**: Expertise in editing, proofreading, and maintaining documentation quality standards
- **User-Centered Design**: Understanding of user needs and content usability principles
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#development-competencies]

### Development Competencies

- **Web Development**: Proficiency in modern web development technologies and frameworks
- **SharePoint Expertise**: Advanced SharePoint development and customization capabilities
- **Integration Skills**: Ability to integrate documentation systems with enterprise platforms
- **Automation**: Understanding of automated workflows and content publishing processes
page_texts.32:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#healthcare--compliance]

### Healthcare & Compliance

- **Regulatory Knowledge**: Understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance documentation requirements
- **Accessibility**: Expertise in creating accessible content that meets government standards
- **Security Awareness**: Knowledge of information security principles and documentation practices
- **Audit Readiness**: Ability to maintain documentation that supports compliance audits
page_texts.33:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#collaboration--process]

### Collaboration & Process

- **Stakeholder Management**: Skills in working with technical teams and subject matter experts
- **Process Improvement**: Ability to optimize documentation workflows and processes
- **Project Coordination**: Experience managing multiple documentation projects simultaneously
- **Change Management**: Understanding of documentation change control and version management

---
page_texts.35:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#documentation-quality--delivery]

### Documentation Quality & Delivery

- Deliver high-quality technical documentation that meets user needs and compliance requirements
- Maintain documentation accuracy, currency, and accessibility across all platforms
- Ensure all documentation adheres to established style guides and standards
- Support successful adoption of documentation by target audiences
page_texts.36:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/technical-writer.md#technology--innovation]

### Technology & Innovation

- Implement modern documentation technologies and best practices
- Develop innovative solutions for content management and user experience
- Optimize documentation workflows and automation processes
- Stay current with emerging technologies and documentation trends

---

_This job description is part of Gainwell's Enterprise Architecture Practice talent acquisition framework._
